name: Bookie
description: A veteran bookie struggles to survive the impending legalization of sports gambling, increasingly unstable clients, family, co-workers, and a lifestyle that bounces him around every corner of Los Angeles, high and low.

videos.title: Always Smell the Money
videos.overview: While collecting debts from clients around LA, Danny and Ray attempt to track down actor Charlie Sheen.

videos.title: Making Lemonade
videos.overview: After a violent run-in leaves them shaken, Danny and Ray attempt to talk a client off the ledge, while Hector aims to weasel his way onto the team.

videos.title: Trust Your Sphincter
videos.overview: While Lorraine's side-hustle backfires, Danny takes a series of high-risk, high-reward bets that could make or break his business.

videos.title: Some Whales Nix the Vig
videos.overview: Having been forced to take an enormous bet, Danny and Ray look for a way out, while Hector and Lorraine pursue running a psychedelic shaman business.

videos.title: Beware the Family Jewels
videos.overview: When a client settles his debts with a bounty of stolen jewelry, Danny and Ray use the baubles to appease the women in their lives.

videos.title: Nepo Bookies
videos.overview: After the passing of his beloved uncle and mentor, Danny faces increasing threats from his estranged cousin, Viggy.

videos.title: The Super Bowl: God's Gift to Bookies
videos.overview: The biggest night in sports brings a windfall of cash to Danny and Ray, but Hector makes a mistake that threatens the money and their lives.

videos.title: A Square Job in a Round Hole
videos.overview: A violent showdown causes Sandy to issue Danny an ultimatum: get legit or risk losing his family for good.

videos.title: Mahnanga
videos.overview: Danny heads to Modesto in search of Sandra, but soon finds himself at odds with his eccentric mother-in-law.

videos.title: Go to the Labia
videos.overview: While Lorraine takes Walt on a spiritual business trip, Hector recruits Danny and Ray to help collect on a soccer bet from a notorious drug lord.

videos.title: Boom, Done, Hello Jesus
videos.overview: Wendy finds herself at the center of a twisted love triangle. Lorraine pivots away from Hector. Danny and Ray hire a very odd banker.

videos.title: Make It Look Like an Accident
videos.overview: As Hector, Walt, and Lorraine squabble over their fledgling psychedelic business, Danny looks for a way to get Wendy out of his life.

videos.title: Fruit's for Partners
videos.overview: After an untimely personal loss, Ray's home life spirals out of control, causing Danny to take Hector under his wing.

videos.title: Spooning Is Not Necrophilia
videos.overview: When a client bets big on the WNBA, Danny and Ray realize their banker – and money – have gone missing.

videos.title: Sphincter Money
videos.overview: After Walt takes ownership of Danny's book, Danny and Ray take off for Costa Rica to assess the future of their business.

videos.title: A Whale in Pomona
videos.overview: A violent showdown in Costa Rica leads to a breakthrough for Danny and Ray. Back in LA, Danny and Marian have realizations of their own.
